Land Rover Discovery
specialist service & repair

The Discovery is the family workhorse, and Discovery 3 and 4 owners know its weak points well. Air suspension, timing chains and crankshaft concerns on the 2.7 and 3.0 diesels are our specialities.

Book on WhatsApp 055 747 9292

Known issues on the Land Rover Discovery

These are the faults that bring Land Rover Discovery owners to us most often. Each has a proven, permanent repair.

  • Front air suspension and compressor on D3/D4
  • Timing chain stretch on 3.0 TDV6/SDV6
  • Crankshaft failure on early 3.0 diesels
  • Lower control arm and bush wear
  • Parking brake actuator failure on D3/D4

Generations: D3, D4, D5 · Years: 2004 – present
Engines covered: 2.7 TDV6, 3.0 TDV6/SDV6, 5.0 V8, 3.0 Ingenium D300, 2.0 Ingenium

Frequently asked questions

How often should a Land Rover Discovery be serviced?

Every 16,000 km or 12 months, with an interim oil change at 8,000 km recommended in Gulf conditions for the 2.7 TDV6 and other engines fitted to the Land Rover Discovery.

What are the most common Land Rover Discovery problems?

On the Land Rover Discovery we most often see front air suspension and compressor on d3/d4, timing chain stretch on 3.0 tdv6/sdv6, crankshaft failure on early 3.0 diesels. All are diagnosed and repaired in-house.

Do you use genuine parts on the Land Rover Discovery?

Yes. Genuine Land Rover parts by default, with high-quality OE-equivalent options offered where they provide better value.
